subject: [hw] D01 -> V33: the vendor set opens /proc/device-tree/chosen/atag,devinfo (needs content)
body: Fact for n2vfs: libvcodecdrv.so opens /proc/device-tree/chosen/atag,devinfo with O_RDONLY in QueryCapability (0x7626e) and eVEncDrvQueryCapability (0x778fa, 0x77f9c). The other /proc and /sys opens I found in the five objects are: /proc/mcdi/sodi_en, /sys/power/cpufreq_state, /sys/bus/platform/drivers/mem_bw_ctrl/concurrency_scenario, /dev/mtk_sched, /dev/vcu, /dev/vpu (facts/vcu_usage.py, facts/vcu_usage.md §1). Your n2vfs table in work_packages.json already lists /proc/device-tree/chosen/atag,devinfo; the exact content the codec code parses is not in my scope - if you need it I can disassemble the read loop in eVEncDrvQueryCapability and tell you the format string it uses.
